title: Werkmeister workspace config (.werkmeister/workspace.yml)
description: Durable source of truth for a workspace's inputs. Generated and re-read by `werkmeister init-workspace`. Unmanaged keys are preserved across writes, so additional properties are allowed.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation.

feature.description: Feature slug — names the workspace, containers, and routing cookie.

work_type.description: Kind of work (e.g. feature, bugfix). Drives workspace scaffolding.

context_strategy.description: Which context layer init-workspace generates and up refreshes. Default icm.

autonomous.description: icm: run stage 01 to `werkmeister pr open` with self-checks instead of human checks. Every strategy: add the Bash and werkmeister workspaces MCP allow rules a headless session needs to .claude/settings.json (recorded in .werkmeister/claude-permissions.json, removed when this turns off).

model.description: Claude model for the workspace's sessions: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full claude-… id. Written to .claude/settings.json (recorded in .werkmeister/claude-permissions.json, so removing it here removes only that value, never a model set by hand) and passed as --model to claude-send / claude-resume. Absent = Claude Code's default.

auto_stop.description: Write a SessionEnd hook to .claude/settings.json that runs `werkmeister stop --if-idle` (#231): when a session in the workspace ends and no other Claude session is open there, this feature's containers stop (slot and volumes kept; `werkmeister up` resumes). Never stops shared infra. Turning it off removes the hook on the next init-workspace / up.

repos.description: Comma-separated repos kept as git worktrees in this workspace (union with the repos owning `services`). `werkmeister init-workspace` reconciles the worktree set to match on every run; removing a repo whose worktree has uncommitted changes requires --force.

services.description: Comma-separated list of services to run locally (kept a flat string for back-compat).

issue_id.description: Issue ID in this machine's issue tracker (overrides.issue_tracker, set by `werkmeister setup`).

project.description: The project (a key of `projects:` in ~/.werkmeister/config.yaml) whose tracker holds issue_id. Absent: the machine's tracker (overrides.issue_tracker).

jira_id.description: Deprecated: replaced by issue_id. Read for old workspaces only; never written.

github_issue.description: Deprecated: replaced by issue_id. Read for old workspaces only; never written.

test_path.description: Path or URL the feature is tested against.

description.description: Short human description of the workspace's purpose.

starting_prompt.description: First instruction seeded to the agent.

standards_override.description: Tunes the CLAUDE.md Standards routing block (see docs/jit-context-system.md).

dev_links.description: Per-workspace dev-link bind mounts. Maps a service name to a list of "host:container[:ro]" specs merged into that service's compose volumes — mount a locally built package over its node_modules copy without editing the global services.yaml. Vars: ${WORKSPACE} (workspace root), ${REPO} (the service's repo dir), ${WERKMEISTER_ROOT}.

env_vars.description: Per-workspace environment variables merged into the generated .env. Rendered after the service URLs and secrets, so a key here overrides a generated one — the supported way to point a workspace at a datastore without hand-editing .env after every regeneration.
